cases.oracle: Same-process /proc VmLck and VmRSS, actual RLIMIT_MEMLOCK, independent libc syscall controls, and recorded seccomp syscall replies. No mock is used to assert a real successful lock.
cases.comparison: Setup proves a real munlockall success on an unlocked owned process, and validates independent EAGAIN mlockall and EIO munlockall injections. Candidate calls run only in disposable shells; raw outputs, actual limits, VmLck/VmRSS and syscall replies are retained. The mlockall injection case first measures the actual candidate resident size in the VM and requires a hard limit at least resident plus 2 MiB before running; otherwise setup reports the required guest limit instead of treating an unreached syscall as a candidate failure. A guarded precompiled listener records its bootstrap stages for each notification trace.
cases.purpose: A zero soft limit triggers the real resident-size precheck without locking pages.
